Chapter 21

Troubleshooting Applications应用排障

When operating an application in a production Kubernetes cluster, failures are almost inevitable. It’s your responsibility as a Kubernetes administrator to be able to troubleshoot issues for the Kubernetes objects designed and deployed by an application developer.

在生产 Kubernetes 集群中运维应用时，故障几乎不可避免。作为 Kubernetes 管理员，你有责任能够为应用开发者设计并部署的 Kubernetes 对象排查问题。

In this chapter, we’ll look at troubleshooting strategies that can help with identifying the root cause of an issue so that you can take action and correct the failure appropriately. The strategies discussed here start with the high-level perspective of a Kubernetes object and then drill into more detail as needed.

本章我们将介绍一些排障策略，帮助你定位问题的根因，从而采取行动、恰当地纠正故障。这里讨论的策略先从 Kubernetes 对象的高层视角入手，再根据需要逐步深入细节。

Coverage of Curriculum Objectives考试大纲覆盖

This chapter addresses the following curriculum objectives: Manage and evaluate container output streams; Troubleshoot services and networking; Monitor cluster and application resource usage.

本章覆盖以下考试大纲目标：管理并评估容器输出流；排查 Service 与网络问题；监控集群与应用的资源使用情况。

Troubleshooting PodsPod 排障

In most cases, creating a Pod is no issue. You simply emit the run, create, or apply commands to instantiate the Pod. If the YAML manifest is formed properly, Kubernetes accepts your request, so the assumption is that everything works as expected. To verify the correct behavior, the first thing you’ll want to do is to check the Pod’s high-level runtime information. The operation could involve other Kubernetes objects like a Deployment responsible for rolling out multiple replicas of a Pod.

在大多数情况下，创建 Pod 本身不是问题。你只需发出 run、create 或 apply 命令来实例化 Pod。如果 YAML manifest 格式正确，Kubernetes 就会接受你的请求，因此可以假设一切按预期运行。要验证行为是否正确，你首先要做的是检查 Pod 的高层运行时信息。这一操作可能涉及其他 Kubernetes 对象，例如负责滚动发布多个 Pod 副本的 Deployment。

— PDF p.293 —

Retrieving High-Level Information获取高层信息

To retrieve the information, run either the kubectl get pods command for just the Pods running in the namespace or the kubectl get all command to retrieve the most prominent object types in the namespace (which includes Deployments). You will want to look at the columns READY, STATUS, and RESTARTS. In the optimal case, the number of ready containers matches the number of containers you defined in the spec. For a single-container Pod, the READY column would say 1/1.

要获取该信息，可以运行 kubectl get pods 只查看 namespace 中运行的 Pod，或运行 kubectl get all 以查看该 namespace 中最主要的对象类型（其中包括 Deployment）。你需要关注 READY、STATUS 和 RESTARTS 这几列。在最理想的情况下，已就绪容器数与你在 spec 中定义的容器数一致；对于单容器 Pod，READY 列应显示 1/1。

The status should say Running to indicate that the Pod entered the proper lifecycle state. Be aware that it’s totally possible that a Pod renders a Running state, but the application isn’t actually working properly. If the number of restarts is greater than 0, then you might want to check the logic of the liveness probe (if defined) and identify the reason a restart was necessary.

状态应显示 Running，表示 Pod 进入了正确的生命周期状态。但要注意：完全可能出现 Pod 显示 Running、而应用实际并未正常工作的情况。如果重启次数大于 0，你可能需要检查存活探针（如果已定义）的逻辑，并弄清为何必须重启。

The following Pod observes the status ErrImagePull and makes 0/1 containers available to incoming traffic. In short, this Pod has a problem:

下面这个 Pod 处于 ErrImagePull 状态，0/1 个容器可接收入站流量。简而言之，这个 Pod 出问题了：

$ kubectl get pods
NAME              READY   STATUS         RESTARTS   AGE
misbehaving-pod   0/1     ErrImagePull   0          2s

After working with Kubernetes for a while, you’ll automatically recognize common error conditions. Table 21-1 lists some of those error statuses and explains how to fix them.

使用 Kubernetes 一段时间后，你会自动识别常见的错误状态。表 21-1 列出了其中一些错误状态，并说明如何修复。

StatusRoot causePotential fix
ImagePullBackOff or ErrImagePullImage could not be pulled from registry.Check correct image name, check that image name exists in registry, verify network access from node to registry, ensure proper authentication.
ImagePullBackOff 或 ErrImagePull无法从镜像仓库拉取镜像。检查镜像名是否正确，确认镜像名在仓库中存在，验证节点到仓库的网络连通性，确保认证正确。
CrashLoopBackOffApplication or command run in container crashes.Check command executed in container, ensure that image can properly execute (e.g., by creating a container with Docker).
CrashLoopBackOff容器中运行的应用或命令崩溃。检查容器中执行的命令，确认镜像能正常执行（例如用 Docker 创建一个容器验证）。
CreateContainerConfigErrorConfigMap or Secret referenced by container cannot be found.Check correct name of the configuration object, verify the existence of the configuration object in the namespace.
CreateContainerConfigError容器引用的 ConfigMap 或 Secret 找不到。检查配置对象的名称是否正确，确认该配置对象在 namespace 中存在。

Inspecting Events检查事件

You might not encounter any of those error statuses. But there’s still a chance of the Pod having a configuration issue. You can retrieve detailed information about the Pod using the kubectl describe pod command to inspect its events.

你可能不会遇到上述任何错误状态，但 Pod 仍可能存在配置问题。你可以使用 kubectl describe pod 命令获取 Pod 的详细信息，检查其事件。

The following output belongs to a Pod that tries to mount a Secret that doesn’t exist. Instead of rendering a specific error message, the Pod gets stuck with the status ContainerCreating:

下面的输出属于一个试图挂载不存在的 Secret 的 Pod。它没有给出明确的错误消息，而是卡在 ContainerCreating 状态：

— PDF p.294 —
$ kubectl get pods
NAME         READY   STATUS              RESTARTS   AGE
secret-pod   0/1     ContainerCreating   0          4m57s
$ kubectl describe pod secret-pod
...
Events:
Type    Reason      Age                  From              Message
----    ------      ----                 ----              -------
Normal  Scheduled   <unknown>            default-scheduler Successfully assigned default/secret-pod to minikube
Warning FailedMount 3m15s                kubelet, minikube Unable to attach or mount volumes: unmounted volumes=[mysecret], unattached volumes=[default-token-bf8rh mysecret]: timed out waiting for the condition
Warning FailedMount 68s (x10 over 5m18s) kubelet, minikube MountVolume.SetUp failed for volume "mysecret" : secret "mysecret" not found
Warning FailedMount 61s                  kubelet, minikube Unable to attach or mount volumes: unmounted volumes=[mysecret], unattached volumes=[mysecret default-token-bf8rh]: timed out waiting for the condition

Another helpful command is kubectl get events. The output of the command lists the events across all Pods for a given namespace. You can use additional command-line options to further filter and sort events:

另一个有用的命令是 kubectl get events。该命令的输出列出给定 namespace 中所有 Pod 的事件。你可以使用额外的命令行选项进一步过滤和排序事件：

$ kubectl get events
LAST SEEN   TYPE      REASON            OBJECT               MESSAGE
3m14s       Warning   BackOff           pod/custom-cmd       Back-off restarting failed container
2s          Warning   FailedNeedsStart  cronjob/google-ping  Cannot determine if job needs to be started: too many missed start time (> 100). Set or decrease .spec.
— PDF p.295 —
startingDeadlineSeconds or check clock skew

Sometimes troubleshooting won’t be enough. You may have to dig into the application runtime behavior and configuration in the container.

有时候仅靠排障还不够，你可能需要深入容器中应用的运行时行为和配置。

Using Port Forwarding使用端口转发

In production environments, you’ll operate an application in multiple Pods controlled by a ReplicaSet. It’s not unusual that one of those replicas experiences a runtime issue. Instead of troubleshooting the problematic Pod from a temporary Pod from within the cluster, you can also forward the traffic to a Pod through a tunneled HTTP connection. This is where the port-forward command comes into play.

在生产环境中，你会在由 ReplicaSet 控制的多个 Pod 中运维一个应用。这些副本中有一个遇到运行时问题并不罕见。你不必从集群内部的一个临时 Pod 去排障，也可以通过一条隧道化的 HTTP 连接把流量转发到某个 Pod。这正是 port-forward 命令的用武之地。

Let’s demonstrate the behavior. The following command creates a new Deployment running NGINX in three replicas:

下面演示其行为。以下命令创建一个新的 Deployment，以三个副本运行 NGINX：

$ kubectl create deployment nginx --image=nginx:1.24.0 --replicas=3 --port=80
deployment.apps/nginx created

The resulting Pod will have unique names derived from the name of the Deployment. Say the Pod nginx-595dff4799-ph4js has an issue you want to troubleshoot:

由此产生的 Pod 会从 Deployment 名称派生唯一的名字。假设 Pod nginx-595dff4799-ph4js 出了问题，你想对它进行排障：

$ kubectl get pods
NAME                     READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
nginx-595dff4799-pfgdg   1/1     Running   0          6m25s
nginx-595dff4799-ph4js   1/1     Running   0          6m25s
nginx-595dff4799-s76s8   1/1     Running   0          6m25s

The port-forward command forwards HTTP connections from a local port to a port exposed by a Pod. This exemplary command forwards port 2500 on your local machine to the container port 80 running in the Pod nginx-595dff4799-ph4js:

port-forward 命令把来自本地端口的 HTTP 连接转发到某个 Pod 暴露的端口。下面这条示例命令把你本机的 2500 端口转发到 Pod nginx-595dff4799-ph4js 中运行的容器端口 80：

$ kubectl port-forward nginx-595dff4799-ph4js 2500:80
Forwarding from 127.0.0.1:2500 -> 80
Forwarding from [::1]:2500 -> 80

The port-forward command runs in the foreground and doesn’t return to the shell prompt, requiring you to either open another terminal to perform calls to the Pod via the forwarded port, or use your shell’s job control features—pressing Ctrl+Z to suspend it followed by bg to run it in the background, or appending & when starting the command (e.g., kubectl port-forward mypod 8080:80 &) to immediately background the process while keeping the port forwarding active.

port-forward 命令在前台运行，不会返回到 shell 提示符，因此你要么另开一个终端通过转发端口对该 Pod 发起调用，要么使用 shell 的作业控制功能：按 Ctrl+Z 挂起它，再用 bg 让它在后台运行；或者在启动命令时追加 &（例如 kubectl port-forward mypod 8080:80 &），让进程立即进入后台，同时保持端口转发生效。

The following command simply checks if the Pod is accessible from your local machine using curl:

下面的命令只是用 curl 检查该 Pod 在你本机是否可访问：

$ curl -Is localhost:2500 | head -n 1
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
— PDF p.296 —

The HTTP response code 200 clearly shows that we can access the Pod from outside of the cluster. The port-forward command is not meant to run for a long time. Its primary purpose is for testing or troubleshooting a Pod without having to expose it with the help of a Service.

HTTP 响应码 200 清楚地表明我们可以从集群外部访问该 Pod。port-forward 命令并不适合长时间运行，其主要用途是在不必借助 Service 把 Pod 暴露出去的情况下，对 Pod 进行测试或排障。

Troubleshooting Containers容器排障

You can interact with the container for a deep-dive into the application’s runtime environment. The next sections will discuss how to inspect logs, open an interactive shell to a container, and debug containers that do not provide a shell.

你可以与容器交互，深入探查应用的运行时环境。接下来的小节将讨论如何查看日志、打开到容器的交互式 shell，以及调试不提供 shell 的容器。

Targeting a specific container定位到特定容器

The commands described in the following sections apply to init and sidecar containers as well. Use the -c or --container command-line flag to target a specific container if you are running more than a single one.

下面小节描述的命令同样适用于 init 容器和 sidecar 容器。如果你运行的不止一个容器，请使用 -c 或 --container 命令行标志来定位到特定容器。

Inspecting Logs查看日志

When troubleshooting a Pod, you can retrieve the next level of details by downloading and inspecting its logs. You may or may not find additional information that points to the root cause of a misbehaving Pod, but it’s definitely worth a look. The YAML manifest shown in Example 21-1 defines a Pod running a shell command.

对 Pod 排障时，你可以通过下载并查看其日志来获取下一层细节。你也许能、也许不能从中找到指向异常 Pod 根因的额外信息，但看一眼绝对值得。示例 21-1 中的 YAML manifest 定义了一个运行 shell 命令的 Pod。

Example 21-1. A Pod running a failing shell command

示例 21-1. 运行一个失败 shell 命令的 Pod

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: incorrect-cmd-pod
spec:
  containers:
  - name: test-container
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "unknown"]

After creating the object, the Pod fails with the status CrashLoopBackOff. Running the logs command reveals that the command run in the container has an issue:

创建该对象后，Pod 以 CrashLoopBackOff 状态失败。运行 logs 命令可以发现容器中运行的命令有问题：

$ kubectl create -f crash-loop-backoff.yaml
pod/incorrect-cmd-pod created
$ kubectl get pods incorrect-cmd-pod
NAME                READY   STATUS              RESTARTS   AGE
incorrect-cmd-pod   0/1     CrashLoopBackOff    5          3m20s
$ kubectl logs incorrect-cmd-pod
/bin/sh: unknown: not found
— PDF p.297 —

The logs command provides two helpful options. The option -f streams the logs, meaning you’ll see new log entries as they’re being produced in real time. The option --previous gets the logs from the previous instantiation of a container, which is helpful if the container has been restarted.

logs 命令提供两个有用的选项。-f 选项会以流式方式输出日志，意味着你能实时看到新产生的日志条目；--previous 选项获取容器上一次实例化时的日志，在容器已重启时很有用。

Opening an Interactive Shell打开交互式 shell

If any of the previous commands don’t point you to the root cause of the failing Pod, it’s time to open an interactive shell to a container. Application developers will know best what behavior to expect from the application at runtime. Inspect the running processes by using the Unix or Windows utility tools, depending on the image run in the container.

如果前面的命令都没能指出失败 Pod 的根因，那就该打开到容器的交互式 shell 了。应用开发者最清楚应用在运行时应表现出什么行为。请根据容器中运行的镜像，使用 Unix 或 Windows 工具来检查运行中的进程。

Say you encounter a situation where a Pod seems to work properly on the surface, as shown in Example 21-2.

假设你遇到这样一种情况：一个 Pod 表面上看起来工作正常，如示例 21-2 所示。

Example 21-2. A Pod periodically writing the current date to a file

示例 21-2. 一个周期性地把当前日期写入文件的 Pod

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: failing-pod
spec:
  containers:
  - args:
    - /bin/sh
    - -c
    - while true; do echo $(date) >> ~/tmp/curr-date.txt; sleep 5; done;
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    name: failing-pod

After creating the Pod, you check the status. It says Running; however, when making a request to the application, the endpoint reports an error. Next, you check the logs. The log output renders an error message that points to a nonexistent directory. Apparently, the directory that the application needs hasn’t been set up correctly:

创建 Pod 后，你检查状态，它显示 Running；然而当向应用发起请求时，端点却报错。接着你查看日志，日志输出指向一个不存在的目录。显然，应用所需的目录没有被正确创建：

$ kubectl create -f failing-pod.yaml
pod/failing-pod created
$ kubectl get pods failing-pod
NAME          READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
failing-pod   1/1     Running   0          5s
$ kubectl logs failing-pod
/bin/sh: can't create /root/tmp/curr-date.txt: nonexistent directory

The exec command opens an interactive shell to troubleshoot in a hands-on fashion. In the following code, we’re using the Unix tools mkdir, cd, and ls inside of the running container to fix the problem. Obviously, the better mitigation strategy is to create the directory from the application or provide an instruction in the Dockerfile:

exec 命令打开一个交互式 shell，以便动手排障。在下面的代码中，我们在运行中的容器里使用 Unix 工具 mkdir、cd 和 ls 来修复问题。显然，更好的缓解策略是由应用自己创建该目录，或在 Dockerfile 中提供相应指令：

— PDF p.298 —
$ kubectl exec failing-pod -it -- /bin/sh
# mkdir -p ~/tmp
# cd ~/tmp
# ls -l
total 4
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root 112 May 9 23:52 curr-date.txt

Interacting with a Distroless Container与 Distroless 容器交互

Some images run in containers are designed to be very minimal for security reasons. For example, the Google distroless images don’t have any Unix utility tools preinstalled. You can’t even open a shell to a container, as it doesn’t come with a shell.

出于安全原因，容器中运行的某些镜像被设计得极其精简。例如 Google 的 distroless 镜像不预装任何 Unix 工具；你甚至无法打开到容器的 shell，因为它根本不带 shell。

Incorporating security best practices for container images为容器镜像融入安全最佳实践

Shipping container images with accessible shells and running with the root user is commonly discouraged, as these aspects can be used as potential attack vectors. Check out the CKS certification to learn more about security concerns in Kubernetes.

通常不建议发布带有可访问 shell 的容器镜像，也不建议以 root 用户运行，因为这些都可能被用作潜在攻击向量。要了解 Kubernetes 中的安全问题，可以学习 CKS 认证。

One of Google’s distroless images is k8s.gcr.io/pause:3.1, shown in Example 21-3.

Google 的 distroless 镜像之一是 k8s.gcr.io/pause:3.1，如示例 21-3 所示。

Example 21-3. Running a distroless image

示例 21-3. 运行一个 distroless 镜像

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: minimal-pod
spec:
  containers:
  - image: k8s.gcr.io/pause:3.1
    name: pause

As you can see in the following exec command, the image doesn’t provide a shell:

如下面的 exec 命令所示，该镜像不提供 shell：

$ kubectl create -f minimal-pod.yaml
pod/minimal-pod created
$ kubectl get pods minimal-pod
NAME          READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
minimal-pod   1/1     Running   0          8s
$ kubectl exec minimal-pod -it -- /bin/sh
OCI runtime exec failed: exec failed: container_linux.go:349: starting container process caused "exec: "/bin/sh": stat /bin/sh: no such file or directory": unknown
command terminated with exit code 126
— PDF p.299 —

Kubernetes offers the concept of ephemeral containers. Those containers are meant to be disposable and have no resilience features like probes. You can deploy an ephemeral container for troubleshooting minimal containers that would usually not allow the use of the exec command.

Kubernetes 提供了临时容器（ephemeral container）的概念。这些容器是一次性的，不具备探针等韧性特性。你可以为排障而部署一个临时容器，用于处理那些通常不允许使用 exec 命令的精简容器。

The debug command can inject an ephemeral container to a running Pod for debugging purposes. The following command adds the ephemeral container running the image busybox to the Pod named minimal-pod and opens an interactive shell for it:

debug 命令可以为调试目的向运行中的 Pod 注入一个临时容器。下面的命令把运行 busybox 镜像的临时容器添加到名为 minimal-pod 的 Pod，并为它打开一个交互式 shell：

$ kubectl debug -it minimal-pod --image=busybox:1.37.0
Defaulting debug container name to debugger-jf98g.
If you don't see a command prompt, try pressing enter.
/ # pwd
/
/ # exit
Session ended, resume using 'kubectl alpha attach minimal-pod -c debugger-jf98g -i -t' command when the pod is running

Troubleshooting Services and NetworkingService 与网络排障

A Service provides a unified network interface for Pods. For full coverage on networking aspects in Kubernetes, see Chapter 17. Here, I want to point out troubleshooting techniques for this primitive.

Service 为 Pod 提供统一的网络接口。关于 Kubernetes 网络方面的完整内容，请参阅第 17 章。这里我想指出针对这一原语的排障技巧。

Service and networking problems in Kubernetes are among the most challenging issues to diagnose because they involve multiple layers: Pod networking, service discovery, DNS resolution, network policies, and ingress controllers. These issues typically manifest as connection timeouts, refused connections, or intermittent failures that can cripple application functionality.

Kubernetes 中的 Service 与网络问题是最难诊断的问题之一，因为它们涉及多个层次：Pod 网络、服务发现、DNS 解析、NetworkPolicy 和 Ingress 控制器。这些问题通常表现为连接超时、连接被拒绝，或间歇性故障，可能使应用功能瘫痪。

Diagnosing Service-to-Pod Label Selection诊断 Service 到 Pod 的标签选择

In case you can’t reach the Pods that should map to the Service, start by ensuring that the label selector matches with the assigned labels of the Pods. You can query the information by describing the Service and then render the labels of the available Pods with the option --show-labels. The following example does not have matching labels and therefore wouldn’t apply to any of the Pods running in the namespace:

如果你无法访问本应映射到该 Service 的 Pod，首先要确保标签选择器与 Pod 所分配的标签匹配。你可以通过 describe Service 来查询该信息，然后用 --show-labels 选项展示可用 Pod 的标签。下面的示例中标签不匹配，因此不会作用于 namespace 中运行的任何 Pod：

$ kubectl describe service myservice
...
Selector:          app=myapp
...
$ kubectl get pods --show-labels
NAME                     READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE     LABELS
myapp-68bf896d89-qfhlv   1/1     Running   0          7m39s   app=hello
myapp-68bf896d89-tzt55   1/1     Running   0          7m37s   app=world
— PDF p.300 —

Diagnosing Service-to-Pod Port Mapping诊断 Service 到 Pod 的端口映射

Services must correctly map ports between the Service definition and the selected Pod’s containers. Check if the port mapping from the target port of the Service to the container port of the Pod is configured correctly. Both ports need to match, or the network traffic wouldn’t be routed properly:

Service 必须在 Service 定义与所选 Pod 的容器之间正确映射端口。请检查从 Service 的 targetPort 到 Pod 容器端口的端口映射是否配置正确。两个端口必须匹配，否则网络流量无法被正确路由：

$ kubectl get service myapp -o yaml | grep targetPort:
    targetPort: 80
$ kubectl get pods myapp-68bf896d89-qfhlv -o yaml | grep containerPort:
    - containerPort: 80

Inspecting the Service’s Endpoints检查 Service 的 Endpoints

A straightforward way to check if label selection and port mapping are set up properly is to inspect the Service’s endpoints. Service endpoints are API objects that represent the network addresses (IP addresses and ports) of the Pods backing a Service. Use the get endpoints command to render a Service’s endpoints. Ensure that the output lists the number of Pod IP addresses and container ports expected to be selected by the Service:

检查标签选择和端口映射是否正确配置的一个直接方法，是查看 Service 的 endpoints。Service endpoint 是表示支撑某个 Service 的 Pod 的网络地址（IP 地址和端口）的 API 对象。使用 get endpoints 命令来展示 Service 的 endpoints。请确保输出列出了 Service 预期选中的 Pod IP 地址和容器端口数量：

$ kubectl get endpoints myservice
NAME        ENDPOINTS                     AGE
myservice   172.17.0.5:80,172.17.0.6:80   9m31s

If the output of the command does not render any endpoints, then you know that either label selection or port mapping has not been configured correctly in the Service.

如果命令输出没有展示任何 endpoints，那么你就知道 Service 中的标签选择或端口映射没有正确配置。

Verifying Accessibility Scope验证可访问范围

Different service types (ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer) have different accessibility scopes. By default, the Service type is ClusterIP, which means that a Pod can be reached through the Service only if queried from inside of the cluster. First, check the Service type:

不同的 Service 类型（ClusterIP、NodePort、LoadBalancer）有不同的可访问范围。默认情况下 Service 类型是 ClusterIP，这意味着只有从集群内部查询时，才能通过该 Service 访问 Pod。首先检查 Service 类型：

$ kubectl get services
NAME         TYPE        CLUSTER-IP      EXTERNAL-IP   PORT(S)   AGE
myservice    ClusterIP   10.99.155.165   <none>        80/TCP    15m
...

If you think that ClusterIP is the proper type you wanted to assign, open an interactive shell from a temporary Pod inside the cluster and run a curl or wget command:

如果你认为 ClusterIP 正是你想赋予的类型，就在集群内部从一个临时 Pod 打开交互式 shell，运行 curl 或 wget 命令：

$ kubectl run tmp --image=busybox:1.37.0 -it --rm -- wget 10.99.155.165:80
— PDF p.301 —

DNS Resolution ProblemsDNS 解析问题

Instead of using the cluster-internal IP address to access a ClusterIP Service, you will likely want to use the Service’s DNS name instead:

你很可能更想使用 Service 的 DNS 名称，而不是用集群内部 IP 地址来访问 ClusterIP Service：

$ kubectl run tmp --image=busybox:1.37.0 -it --rm -- wget myservice:80

Before jumping to any conclusions, remember that Services in different namespaces require fully qualified domain names (FQDN). The more bulletproof option to check accessibility to a Service is to include the namespace:

在下任何结论之前，请记住：不同 namespace 中的 Service 需要使用完全限定域名（FQDN）。检查 Service 可访问性时更稳妥的做法是带上 namespace：

$ kubectl run tmp --image=busybox:1.37.0 -it --rm -- wget \
  myservice.default.svc.cluster.local:80

DNS issues can prevent Pods from resolving service names, causing application failures. It’s possible that the CoreDNS Pods are currently not running. You can check by executing the following command:

DNS 问题会阻止 Pod 解析 Service 名称，从而导致应用失败。有可能 CoreDNS Pod 当前没有运行。你可以执行以下命令检查：

$ kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l k8s-app=kube-dns

To scan the CoreDNS logs for error messages, run the following command:

要扫描 CoreDNS 日志中的错误消息，运行以下命令：

$ kubectl logs -n kube-system -l k8s-app=kube-dns --tail=50

CoreDNS logs reveal DNS-related problems through various error patterns that help identify the root cause of service discovery failures. Common issues include upstream connectivity problems where CoreDNS cannot reach external DNS servers, resolution failures for Services that don’t exist or are incorrectly referenced, communication breakdowns with the Kubernetes API server preventing Service discovery, configuration problems causing routing loops or processing errors, and performance issues from either excessive query loads or insufficient resources. By recognizing these patterns in the logs, you can quickly determine whether the problem lies in network connectivity, configuration, or resource allocation.

CoreDNS 日志通过各种错误模式揭示与 DNS 相关的问题，帮助你识别服务发现失败的根因。常见问题包括：CoreDNS 无法到达外部 DNS 服务器的上游连通性问题、对不存在或被错误引用的 Service 的解析失败、与 Kubernetes API server 通信中断导致服务发现无法进行、配置问题引发路由循环或处理错误，以及因查询负载过大或资源不足导致的性能问题。通过在日志中识别这些模式，你可以快速判断问题究竟出在网络连通性、配置还是资源分配上。

Network Policy RestrictionsNetworkPolicy 限制

Network policies in Kubernetes act as a firewall at the Pod level, controlling which Pods can communicate with each other and what external traffic is allowed. When network policies are implemented, they follow a “default deny” model—once any network policy selects a Pod, that Pod becomes isolated and can only receive traffic explicitly allowed by policies.

Kubernetes 中的 NetworkPolicy 充当 Pod 层级的防火墙，控制哪些 Pod 可以相互通信、允许哪些外部流量。当实施 NetworkPolicy 时，它们遵循“默认拒绝”模型——一旦任何 NetworkPolicy 选中某个 Pod，该 Pod 就被隔离，只能接收策略显式允许的流量。

This security feature, while essential for production environments, frequently causes mysterious connectivity issues where applications that previously worked suddenly experience timeouts or connection refused errors. Common symptoms include Pods being unable to reach services they depend on, health checks failing, cross-namespace communication breaking, or external traffic being blocked unexpectedly.

这一安全特性虽然对生产环境至关重要，却经常引发神秘的连通性问题：以前能用的应用突然出现超时或连接被拒绝错误。常见症状包括：Pod 无法访问它所依赖的服务、健康检查失败、跨 namespace 通信中断，或外部流量被意外阻断。

— PDF p.302 —

The challenge with troubleshooting network policies lies in their implicit nature—there’s no immediate error message indicating that a network policy is blocking traffic; instead, connections simply fail silently.

NetworkPolicy 排障的挑战在于其隐式特性：没有即时的错误消息指出是 NetworkPolicy 在阻断流量；连接只是无声地失败。

Debugging requires systematically checking if network policies exist in the namespace, understanding which Pods they select through their podSelector, examining the ingress and egress rules to see what traffic is permitted, and testing connectivity from different source Pods to identify exactly where the policy enforcement is occurring.

调试时需要系统地检查 namespace 中是否存在 NetworkPolicy、通过其 podSelector 理解它选中了哪些 Pod、检查 ingress 和 egress 规则以了解允许哪些流量，并从不同的源 Pod 测试连通性，以精确定位策略是在哪里生效的。

The following command checks if any network policies exist in the namespace production:

下面的命令检查 namespace production 中是否存在任何 NetworkPolicy：

$ kubectl get networkpolicies -n production

To see which Pods are affected by network policies, render its details. The following command assumes that we found the network policy api-policy to exist:

要查看哪些 Pod 受 NetworkPolicy 影响，展示其详情。下面的命令假设我们发现存在 NetworkPolicy api-policy：

$ kubectl describe networkpolicy api-policy -n production

Lastly, try to test connectivity from one Pod to another one either directly or through a Service in the same namespace. The following command runs a curl command against a Service named backend-service:

最后，尝试从一个 Pod 到另一个 Pod 测试连通性，可以直接测试，也可以通过同一 namespace 中的某个 Service 测试。下面的命令对名为 backend-service 的 Service 运行 curl：

$ kubectl exec -it frontend-pod -n production -- curl http://backend-service:8080

If this times out, but the backend is running, it’s fair to assume that the network policy comes into play here.

如果这一步超时、而后端正在运行，那么可以合理地认为是 NetworkPolicy 在起作用。

Inspecting Resource Metrics查看资源指标

Deploying software to a Kubernetes cluster is only the start of operating an application long-term. Developers need to understand their applications’ resource consumption patterns and behaviors, with the goal of providing a scalable and reliable service. In the Kubernetes world, monitoring tools like Prometheus and Datadog help with collecting, processing, and visualizing information over time. The exam does not expect you to be familiar with third-party monitoring, logging, tracing, and aggregation tools; however, it is helpful to have a basic understanding of the underlying Kubernetes infrastructure responsible for collecting usage metrics. The following are examples of typical metrics:

把软件部署到 Kubernetes 集群只是长期运维应用的开始。开发者需要理解其应用的资源消耗模式与行为，目标是提供可扩展、可靠的服务。在 Kubernetes 的世界里，Prometheus、Datadog 等监控工具帮助随时间收集、处理和可视化信息。考试并不要求你熟悉第三方监控、日志、链路追踪和聚合工具；但对负责收集使用指标的底层 Kubernetes 基础设施有基本理解会很有帮助。以下是典型指标的例子：

  • Number of nodes in the cluster集群中的节点数量
  • Health status of nodes节点的健康状态
  • Node performance metrics such as CPU, memory, disk space节点性能指标，如 CPU、内存、磁盘空间
  • Pod-level performance metrics such as CPU and memory consumptionPod 级性能指标，如 CPU 和内存消耗
— PDF p.303 —

This responsibility falls to the Metrics Server, a cluster-wide aggregator of resource usage data. As shown in Figure 21-1, kubelets running on nodes collect metrics and send them to the Metrics Server.

这一职责由 Metrics Server 承担，它是一个集群范围的资源使用数据聚合器。如图 21-1 所示，运行在节点上的 kubelet 收集指标并发送给 Metrics Server。

The Metrics Server stores data in memory and does not persist data over time. If you are looking for a solution that keeps historical data, then you need to look into commercial or self-hosted options. Refer to the documentation for more information on its installation process.

Metrics Server 在内存中存储数据，不会随时间持久化。如果你需要能保留历史数据的方案，就要考虑商业或自托管选项。有关其安装过程的更多信息，请参阅文档。

If you’re using minikube as your practice environment, enabling the Metrics Server add-on is straightforward using the following command:

如果你使用 minikube 作为练习环境，用以下命令启用 Metrics Server 附加组件非常简单：

$ minikube addons enable metrics-server
The 'metrics-server' addon is enabled

You can now query for metrics of cluster nodes and Pods with the top command:

现在你可以用 top 命令查询集群节点和 Pod 的指标：

$ kubectl top nodes
NAME       CPU(cores)   CPU%   MEMORY(bytes)   MEMORY%
minikube   283m         14%    1262Mi          32%
$ kubectl top pod frontend
NAME       CPU(cores)   MEMORY(bytes)
frontend   0m           2Mi

It takes a couple of minutes after the installation of the Metrics Server before it has gathered information about resource consumption. Rerun the kubectl top command if you receive the error message error: Metrics API not available.

Metrics Server 安装后需要几分钟时间才能收集到资源消耗信息。如果收到错误消息 error: Metrics API not available，请重新运行 kubectl top 命令。

Summary本章小结

This chapter discussed strategies for approaching failed or misbehaving Pods. The main goal is to diagnose the root cause of a failure and then fix it by taking the right action. Troubleshooting Pods doesn’t have to be hard. With the right kubectl commands in your tool belt, you can rule out root causes one by one to get a clearer picture.

本章讨论了处理失败或异常 Pod 的策略。主要目标是诊断故障的根因，然后采取正确行动修复它。Pod 排障不必很难；只要工具带上有合适的 kubectl 命令，你就能逐一排除根因，让情况逐渐清晰。

— PDF p.304 —

Effective Kubernetes network troubleshooting follows a systematic approach that begins with verifying the fundamentals, ensuring Pods are running, Services have healthy endpoints, and DNS resolution is functioning, before moving to more complex investigations. Most importantly, understand the capabilities and limitations of each Service type (ClusterIP for internal traffic, NodePort for node-level access, and LoadBalancer for external exposure) to set appropriate expectations and choose the right troubleshooting approach for each scenario.

有效的 Kubernetes 网络排障遵循系统化方法：先验证基本面——确保 Pod 正在运行、Service 有健康的 endpoints、DNS 解析正常——然后再进入更复杂的调查。最重要的是，理解每种 Service 类型的能力与局限（ClusterIP 用于内部流量、NodePort 用于节点级访问、LoadBalancer 用于外部暴露），以便设定恰当的预期，并为每种场景选择正确的排障方法。

The Kubernetes ecosystem provides a lot of options for collecting and processing metrics of your cluster over time. Among those options are monitoring tools like Prometheus and Datadog. Many of those tools use the Metrics Server as the source of truth for those metrics. We also briefly touched on the installation process and the kubectl top command for retrieving metrics from the command line.

Kubernetes 生态系统为随时间收集和处理集群指标提供了很多选项，其中包括 Prometheus、Datadog 等监控工具。这些工具中许多都以 Metrics Server 作为指标的事实来源。我们还简要提及了安装过程以及从命令行获取指标的 kubectl top 命令。

Exam Essentials考试要点

  • Know how to troubleshoot applications. Applications running in a Pod can easily break due to misconfiguration. Think of possible scenarios that can occur and try to model them proactively to represent a failure situation. Then using the commands get, logs, and exec, get to the bottom of the issue and fix it. Try to dream up obscure scenarios to become more comfortable with finding and fixing application issues for different resource types. Refer to the Kubernetes documentation to learn more about debugging other Kubernetes resource types.了解如何对应用排障。Pod 中运行的应用很容易因配置错误而故障。设想可能发生的场景，并主动建模以模拟失败情境；然后使用 get、logs 和 exec 命令弄清问题到底出在哪里并修复它。试着虚构一些冷门场景，让自己更自如地为不同资源类型查找和修复应用问题。请参阅 Kubernetes 文档，了解更多关于调试其他 Kubernetes 资源类型的内容。
  • Make accessing container logs your daily bread and butter. Accessing container logs is straightforward. Simply use the logs command. Practice the use of all relevant command-line options. The option -c targets a specific container. The option does not have to be used explicitly for single-container Pods. The option -f follows the log entries if you want to see live processing in an application. The -p option can be used for accessing logs if the container needed to be restarted, but you still want to take a look at the previous container logs.把查看容器日志当作你的看家本领。查看容器日志非常直接：使用 logs 命令即可。练习所有相关命令行选项的用法。-c 选项用于定位到特定容器；对于单容器 Pod，不必显式使用该选项。-f 选项用于实时跟踪日志条目，让你看到应用的实时处理过程。-p 选项用于在容器不得不重启、但你仍想查看上一次容器日志时使用。
  • Know how to diagnose networking issues. Follow a systematic approach: first verify basic connectivity and DNS, then check service endpoints and selectors, examine port configurations, investigate any network policies, and finally test the complete traffic path from source to destination. Always remember that the exam environment may have preconfigured network policies or specific networking plug-ins that affect troubleshooting strategies.了解如何诊断网络问题。遵循系统化方法：先验证基本连通性和 DNS，再检查 Service 的 endpoints 和选择器，检查端口配置，调查任何 NetworkPolicy，最后测试从源到目的地的完整流量路径。请始终记住，考试环境可能已预先配置了 NetworkPolicy 或特定网络插件，从而影响排障策略。
— PDF p.305 —
  • Learn how to retrieve and interpret resource metrics. Monitoring a Kubernetes cluster is an important aspect of successfully operating in a real-world environment. You should read up on commercial monitoring products and which data the Metrics Server can collect. You can assume that the exam environment provides you with an installation of the Metrics Server. Learn how to use the kubectl top command to render Pod and node resource metrics and how to interpret them.学习如何获取并解读资源指标。监控 Kubernetes 集群是在真实环境中成功运维的重要方面。你应了解商业监控产品以及 Metrics Server 能收集哪些数据。可以假设考试环境已为你安装了 Metrics Server。学习如何使用 kubectl top 命令展示 Pod 和节点的资源指标，以及如何解读它们。

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的解答见附录 A。

  1. In this exercise, you will practice your troubleshooting skills by inspecting a misconfigured Pod. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch21/troubleshooting-pod of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Create a new Pod from the YAML manifest in the file setup.yaml. Check the Pod’s status. Do you see any issues? Render the logs of the running container and identify an issue. Shell into the container. Can you verify the issue based on the rendered log message? Suggest solutions that can fix the root cause of the issue.在本练习中，你将通过检查一个配置错误的 Pod 来练习排障技能。进入已 checkout 的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 中的目录 app-a/ch21/troubleshooting-pod。从文件 setup.yaml 中的 YAML manifest 创建一个新 Pod。检查 Pod 的状态，你看到任何问题了吗？展示运行中容器的日志并识别问题。shell 进入该容器。你能根据所展示的日志消息验证问题吗？提出能修复该问题根因的解决方案。
  2. Kate is a developer in charge of implementing a web-based application stack. She is not familiar with Kubernetes, and asked if you could help out. The relevant objects have been created; however, connection to the application cannot be established from within the cluster. Help Kate with fixing the configuration of her YAML manifests. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch21/troubleshooting-service of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Create the objects from the YAML manifest setup.yaml. Inspect the objects in the namespace y72. Create a temporary Pod using the image busybox:1.36.1 in the namespace y72. The container command should make a wget call to the Service web-app. The wget call will not be able to establish a successful connection to the Service. Identify the root cause for the connection issue and fix it. Verify the correct behavior by repeating the previous step. The wget call should return a successful response.Kate 是一名负责实现 Web 应用栈的开发者。她不熟悉 Kubernetes，问你能否帮忙。相关对象已经创建；但从集群内部无法建立到该应用的连接。帮 Kate 修复她 YAML manifest 的配置。进入已 checkout 的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 中的目录 app-a/ch21/troubleshooting-service。从 YAML manifest setup.yaml 创建对象。检查 namespace y72 中的对象。在 namespace y72 中使用镜像 busybox:1.36.1 创建一个临时 Pod。容器命令应向 Service web-app 发起 wget 调用。该 wget 调用将无法与 Service 建立成功连接。找出该连接问题的根因并修复它。重复上一步以验证正确行为：wget 调用应返回成功响应。
  3. You will inspect the metrics collected by the Metrics Server. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch21/stress-test of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. The current directory contains the YAML manifests for three Pods, stress-1-pod.yaml, stress-2-pod.yaml, and stress-3-pod.yaml. Inspect those manifest files. Create the namespace stress-test and the Pods inside of the namespace. Use the data available through the Metrics Server to identify which of the Pods consumes the most memory. Prerequisite: You will need to install the Metrics Server if you want to be able to inspect actual resource metrics. You can find installation instructions on the project’s GitHub page.你将检查 Metrics Server 收集的指标。进入已 checkout 的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 中的目录 app-a/ch21/stress-test。当前目录包含三个 Pod 的 YAML manifest：stress-1-pod.yaml、stress-2-pod.yaml 和 stress-3-pod.yaml。检查这些 manifest 文件。创建 namespace stress-test，并在该 namespace 中创建这些 Pod。利用 Metrics Server 提供的数据，识别哪个 Pod 消耗的内存最多。前置条件：如果你想检查真实的资源指标，需要安装 Metrics Server。安装说明可在该项目的 GitHub 页面找到。
